build_FPN_feature_pyramid: build a Feature Pyramid Network with specified in_channels, out_channels, and num_outs for object detection
create_FPN_with_extra_convs: create an FPN instance with add_extra_convs set to on_input for RetinaNet style feature extraction
run_FPN_forward_pass: run a forward pass through FPN with a tuple of backbone feature tensors as input
review_FPN_initialization: review the FPN class initialization to configure lateral_convs and fpn_convs ModuleLists for multi-scale features
test_FPN_output_shapes: test the FPN forward method to verify output tensors match expected multi-scale pyramid shapes
